cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Don't call the taxi. I thought I'd taught you to keep our money worries between us. We need to finish this before dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologized for telling my sister about your debt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you can name what you did. Now stay and hear why I can't face her watching what I order.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's already paid for dinner. We'll be late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then be late with me. You're still solving the bill instead of listening, like you used to. Sit down until I can believe you're going as my partner, not her reporter.
